scope: Task A: complete bounded repository-declared scheduler/service directory; Mac/cloud/CI/manual/disabled variants separate; not runtime or business-health census.

coverage.basis: Static declarations only at fixed Git baseline; runtime inventories B/F are separate and authoritative for their observations.
source_priority: Tracked unit snapshot and generator-consumed ini fields, both retained if divergent
Literal code registry and tracked launchd/workflow config
file_matching: Read-only git ls-files for *.plist/*.service/*.timer/*crontab*; all11 tracked plist files included, including scripts/.disabled
docs/deploy/systemd-units-20260912.md exact generator TITLE_RE and first ini block; generator not executed
docs/deploy/systemd-units-cloud-snapshot.txt @@@FILE sections; parse text, not live systemctl
scripts/gen_schedule_stats.py literal AST assignments TASKS/EXTRA_MARKER_SCANS/TASK_UNITS/UNIT_ONLY/SELF_MONITOR_UNITS; no import/_mk_registry execution
.github/workflows/*.yml every job; scheduler/deploy references in non-test scripts read statically
exclusions: scripts/tests fixtures, node_modules/venv/worktree contents, data/logs are not service declarations
All unrelated historical Markdown timetables are not promoted to current config
No actual LaunchAgents, cron/systemd runtime, live cloud, env/credentials or private chats read
Individual arbitrary CLI helpers/subscripts are not separate scheduled task records without an explicit scheduler/launch declaration
No per-child transitive dependency proof; unresolved path references are candidates only
unknowns: Loaded/enabled/masked/running state, actual host timezone, business health and normal-cycle outcome
Full effective lock/retry/inner-timeout/calling graph for every child script
Jobs/cron outside repository or installed manually without tracked template
GitHub runtime/release/deploy success; no runtime scheduler call performed

template_parse_issues.scope: Template syntax only; not runtime failure evidence.
